backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality including product management, shopping cart, user profiles, Stripe integration, branding/homepage configuration, order management, and access control with admin/user roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two features: adding description field to BulkProductUpload auto-copy functionality and changing platform currency to Australian dollars (AUD) across all price-displaying components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and configuration files describing their functionality, including marketplace, dashboard, product management, checkout flow, and branding features.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining design tokens for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, including variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Original Creations Hub' and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment success/failure, terms, and privacy policy, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dynamic branding hook and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and form submission to update backend branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, allowing users to set name, description, shape, price, and inventory for each product. Includes auto-copy functionality to replicate first product's fields to others and an AI-like description generator based on product attributes.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site branding, legal links (Terms & Privacy Policy), contact email from shop details, and a caffeine.ai attribution link. Includes navigation handlers and responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings component for customizing homepage hero section, allowing updates to hero motto, promotional text, and hero image with upload progress tracking. Form validates required fields and handles image file uploads via ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing site header with logo/branding, authentication controls, navigation to basket and dashboard, and cart item count badge. Includes sticky header, Internet Identity integration, and Footer component.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, shape, and price with an "Add to Basket" button. Handles add-to-cart mutations and formats AUD currency prices.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog for detailed product view showing full product information with larger image, description, and action buttons for "Add to Basket" and "Buy Now". Handles direct checkout navigation for buy-now flow.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing (name, description, price, images) and inventory adjustment controls (increment/decrement buttons).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled profile setup modal component that returns null; previously used for post-login user profile configuration.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form component for configuring shop details including name, address, contact information, opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form component for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key input and allowed countries selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: React hook that dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and providing login/logout functionality with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including products, user profiles, cart, orders, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, and homepage settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color theme for both light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart items or buy-now products, calculates totals, and initiates Stripe checkout sessions with success/cancel URLs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with authentication checks, Stripe setup flow, and tabbed interface for managing products, bulk uploads, branding, shop details, and homepage settings with inventory statistics.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying hero section with configurable background, featured products, and categorized product sections (most viewed, best selling, newest) with product detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success confirmation page that clears the cart and buy-now session data, displaying success message with option to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, cookies, and contact details in a formatted card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page component that displays cart items with quantity controls, removal functionality, price formatting, and checkout navigation using React Query hooks and shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static Terms & Conditions page displaying legal information about products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, and liability using a Card component layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with custom fonts (Inter, Crimson Pro), shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining an artisan marketplace with bulk image upload, AI descriptions, Stripe integration, shopping cart functionality, and tracking known issues like image persistence failures and checkout redirect problems.
